non_blocking_notes: The TodoContext.tsx change (synchronous localStorage.save in mutations) fixes a pre-existing async persistence bug, not a calendar feature. It prevents the race condition where page.reload() fires before useEffect saves to localStorage.
Calendar implementation itself stays within allowed paths: calendar.ts, CalendarGrid.tsx, DayPanel.tsx, CalendarPage.tsx, index.ts files.
No calendar-specific types, reducers, or data layer additions were made.
